what: 01295 engine half is in the tree: Vtable.fields, Input::FIELD_NAMES / Tracked::TRACKED_FIELD_NAMES (the macros emit the field idents, bare as salsa named them: `data`, `modules`), Storage::field_name(ingredient, field) and Storage::read_name(key, kind) (a field read by its field name, any other by its ingredient name). The callers still name a field read by its struct: in body_store.rs:258 and goal_store.rs:354 replace `storage.ingredient_name(read.ingredient_index())` with `storage.read_name(read, kind)`. RULES in blaze-item-hash reads.rs then match unchanged.
why: wrong owner: both paths are hir-ty (crates/hir-ty/src/body_store.rs:258, next_solver/goal_store.rs:354), which crates.md gives to db (queries) / items; tests-misc-front1 edits only hir, hir-firewall, hir-lint-levels, blaze-items, blaze-item-hash. The change is two lines: `storage.ingredient_name(read.ingredient_index())` -> `storage.read_name(read, kind)` at each. blaze-item-hash reads.rs RULES already list the bare field names (data, cfg_options, extra_data, workspace_data, modules), so the 3 classify tests need only that. Owner: db.
